stateRecovery.settings.title: Cmdr couldn’t read your settings, so it started with the defaults

@stateRecovery.settings.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once at launch: Cmdr's settings file was damaged (for example by a crash or a full disk while it was being saved), so Cmdr set it aside and started with default settings. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.settings.body: Usage stats and crash reports stay off until you turn them back on in Settings › Updates & privacy.

@stateRecovery.settings.body.description: Body of the notice above. Cmdr turned two privacy settings off on purpose (the person may have turned them off before, and Cmdr can't tell any more), and this says how to turn them back on. "Settings › Updates & privacy" names the settings window and its section: keep the › separator and use the section's translated name. Plain text. Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

@stateRecovery.settings.openSettings.description: Button on the notice above that opens Cmdr's Settings on the Updates & privacy section. VERB phrase, short control label. Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.shortcuts.title: Cmdr couldn’t read your keyboard shortcuts, so they’re back to the defaults

@stateRecovery.shortcuts.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: the file holding the person's custom keyboard shortcuts was damaged, so Cmdr set it aside and every shortcut is back to its default key. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.license.title: Cmdr couldn’t read its license file

@stateRecovery.license.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: the file where Cmdr keeps license details was damaged, so Cmdr set it aside. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.license.body: If Cmdr shows as unlicensed now, enter your license key again in Settings › License.

@stateRecovery.license.body.description: Body of the notice above: what to do if the license no longer shows. "Settings › License" names the settings window and its section: keep the › separator and use the section's translated name. Plain text. Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

@stateRecovery.license.openSettings.description: Button on the notice above that opens Cmdr's Settings on the License section. VERB phrase, short control label. Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.appStatus.title: Cmdr couldn’t read which folders your panes had open, so they start at your home folder

@stateRecovery.appStatus.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once at launch: the file remembering each pane's folders, tabs, and layout was damaged, so both panes open at the home folder with the default layout. "Cmdr" is the product name; a "pane" is one of the two side-by-side file lists. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.operationLog.title: Cmdr couldn’t read your operation log, so it starts fresh

@stateRecovery.operationLog.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: the operation log (the record of past file operations that undo reads) was damaged, so earlier operations can't be undone any more; new ones can. “Operation log” is the name the rest of Cmdr uses for it: use the same words as operationLog.dialog.title. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.chatHistory.title: Cmdr couldn’t read your Ask Cmdr chats, so the chat list starts empty

@stateRecovery.chatHistory.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: the file holding the person's conversations with Ask Cmdr (Cmdr's built-in AI assistant) was damaged, so earlier chats are gone from the app. "Cmdr" and "Ask Cmdr" are product names. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.favorites.title: Cmdr couldn’t read your favorites, so the list starts empty

@stateRecovery.favorites.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: the file holding the person's favorite folders was damaged, so the favorites list is empty now. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.goToPathHistory.title: Cmdr couldn’t read your recent Go to folder entries, so the list starts fresh

@stateRecovery.goToPathHistory.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: the list of recently visited paths in the "Go to folder" dialog was damaged, so it's empty now. "Go to folder" is the dialog's name: use its translated title (goToPath.dialog.title). "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.searchHistory.title: Cmdr couldn’t read your recent searches, so the list starts fresh

@stateRecovery.searchHistory.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: the list of recent searches in the search dialog was damaged, so it's empty now. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.selectionHistory.title: Cmdr couldn’t read your recent selections, so the list starts fresh

@stateRecovery.selectionHistory.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: the list of recent selection patterns in the Selection dialog (the one that selects files by name or pattern) was damaged, so it's empty now. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.multiRenamePresets.title: Cmdr couldn’t read your saved multi-rename presets, so the list starts empty

@stateRecovery.multiRenamePresets.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: the file holding the person's saved presets for the multi-rename tool (renames many files at once by rules) was damaged, so no presets are saved now. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.multiRenameLastSettings.ti: Cmdr couldn’t read your last multi-rename settings, so the tool opens with the defaults

@stateRecovery.multiRenameLastSettings.t.description: Headline of a notice shown once: the multi-rename tool (renames many files at once by rules) remembers the settings it last ran with, and that file was damaged, so it opens with its default settings next time. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.multiRenameFieldHistory.ti: Cmdr couldn’t read your multi-rename field history, so it starts fresh

@stateRecovery.multiRenameFieldHistory.t.description: Headline of a notice shown once: the multi-rename tool (renames many files at once by rules) remembers what its text fields held in earlier runs, and that file was damaged, so the history is empty now. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.launchDays.title: Cmdr couldn’t read its record of the days you opened it, so the count starts over

@stateRecovery.launchDays.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: Cmdr keeps a local, never-shared list of the days it was opened (it decides when to show a few tips), and that file was damaged, so the count starts from today. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.s3Places.title: Cmdr couldn’t read all your saved S3 places, so some may be missing

@stateRecovery.s3Places.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: the file holding the person's saved S3 cloud storage accounts and bucket places couldn't be read, either the whole file or only some entries in it (for example ones saved by a newer Cmdr version), so some or all of them are missing from the list now. Passwords and keys are safe; they're stored elsewhere. "S3" is a technical name for this kind of cloud storage and stays as is. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.nfsPlaces.title: Cmdr couldn’t read all your saved NFS places, so some may be missing

@stateRecovery.nfsPlaces.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: the file holding the person's saved NFS servers and their shared folders (exports) couldn't be read, either the whole file or only some entries in it (for example ones saved by a newer Cmdr version), so some or all of them are missing from the list now. "NFS" is a technical name for this kind of network file sharing and stays as is. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.sftpServers.title: Cmdr couldn’t read all your saved SFTP servers, so some may be missing

@stateRecovery.sftpServers.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: the file holding the person's saved SFTP servers couldn't be read, either the whole file or only some entries in it (for example ones saved by a newer Cmdr version), so some or all of them are missing from the list now. Passwords are safe; they're stored elsewhere. "SFTP" is a protocol name and stays as is. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.webdavServers.title: Cmdr couldn’t read all your saved WebDAV servers, so some may be missing

@stateRecovery.webdavServers.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: the file holding the person's saved WebDAV servers couldn't be read, either the whole file or only some entries in it (for example ones saved by a newer Cmdr version), so some or all of them are missing from the list now. Passwords are safe; they're stored elsewhere. "WebDAV" is a protocol name and stays as is. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.smbShares.title: Cmdr couldn’t read all your saved SMB shares, so some may be missing

@stateRecovery.smbShares.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: the file holding the person's saved SMB network shares (shared folders on other computers or a NAS) and their per-share choices couldn't be read, either the whole file or only some entries in it (for example ones saved by a newer Cmdr version), so some or all of them are missing now. Passwords are safe; they're stored elsewhere. "SMB" is a protocol name and stays as is. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.smbServers.title: Cmdr couldn’t read all the servers you added by address, so some may be missing

@stateRecovery.smbServers.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: the file holding the network servers the person added by typing their address (rather than ones Cmdr found on the network by itself) couldn't be read, either the whole file or only some entries in it (for example ones saved by a newer Cmdr version), so some or all of them are missing from the list now. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.sftpHostKeys.title: Cmdr couldn’t read all the SFTP servers you trusted, so it may ask about some of them again

@stateRecovery.sftpHostKeys.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: Cmdr remembers which SFTP servers the person approved the first time they connected (by each server's security fingerprint, its "host key"), and that file couldn't be read, either the whole file or only some entries in it. So for some or all of those servers, Cmdr will show the first-connection approval question again. "SFTP" is a protocol name and stays as is. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.webdavCertificates.title: Cmdr couldn’t read all the server certificates you trusted, so it may ask about some of them again

@stateRecovery.webdavCertificates.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: Cmdr remembers which WebDAV servers’ HTTPS certificates the person chose to trust although macOS didn’t (usually a home NAS that made its own certificate), and that file couldn’t be read, either the whole file or only some entries in it. So for some or all of those servers, Cmdr will show the trust question again. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.localAi.title: Cmdr couldn’t read its local AI setup, so it may offer to set it up again

@stateRecovery.localAi.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: Cmdr keeps a small file about its on-device AI (whether the AI model is downloaded and installed, and whether the person dismissed the offer to install it), and that file couldn't be read, so Cmdr may offer the local AI setup or download again. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.credentials.title: Cmdr couldn’t read your saved passwords and keys, so it starts fresh

@stateRecovery.credentials.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once, on Linux computers without a system keyring only: Cmdr keeps saved server passwords, AI API keys, and the license key in its own encrypted file there, locked to this computer. After a move to a new computer (or a reinstall), that file can't be opened any more, so Cmdr set it aside and started an empty one. "Cmdr" is the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.credentials.body: This happens after a move to a new computer. Cmdr asks for each password again the next time it needs it.

@stateRecovery.credentials.body.description: Body of the notice above: why the saved passwords are gone (the file is locked to the computer it was saved on) and what happens next (Cmdr asks again when it connects). Plain text. Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.keptCopy: Cmdr kept the old file at {path}.

@stateRecovery.keptCopy.description: Line under any of the notices above that a damaged file was set aside rather than deleted, and where. Plain text. Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

placeholders.path: the full path of the set-aside copy, like /Users/anna/Library/Application Support/com.veszelovszki.cmdr/settings.json.broken-2026-10-16T101500. Never translated.

@stateRecovery.showInFinder.description: Button on any of the notices above that opens a Finder window with the set-aside copy of the damaged file highlighted. VERB phrase (imperative). ❗ "Finder" is Apple's app name and stays verbatim as "Finder" in every language. Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

@stateRecovery.dismiss.description: Button on any of the notices above that closes it. The notice doesn't come back. VERB, imperative, short control label. Pop-up notice (toast) in the corner of Cmdr's main window.

stateRecovery.smbLinkConsents.title: Cmdr couldn’t read all the servers you let SMB links sign in to, so it may ask about some of them again

@stateRecovery.smbLinkConsents.title.description: Headline of a notice shown once: Cmdr remembers which other servers the person let links in SMB shares sign in to, and that file couldn’t be read. "SMB" is a protocol name; "Cmdr" the product name. Sentence case, no full stop. Avoid the words "error" and "failed". Pop-up notice (toast).
